claims.claim: Motivational, business, relationship and self development books
claims.evidence: Witness photos show multiple business/self-help titles (e.g., “Influence People”, “Small Business Big Money”, “Compound Effect”, “This Is Marketing”, “Women Rise Up”, “Bringing Out the Best in Your Marriage”).

claims.claim: Everything is clean and dry (no water added)
claims.evidence: Photos show book covers laid out, but do not clearly confirm absence of hidden dampness, mildew smell, or internal page damage.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: No scale reading, certification, or weighing video/receipt is shown in the witness report.
Witness describes books laid out in rows and the photos show organized spreads.

risks.risk: Wrong quantity/weight (e.g., far less than claimed), which directly affects value
risks.proof: A short video of the seller weighing the full bundle on a certified scale with the scale reading visible, plus a clear shot of the bundle before and after weighing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an assorted bundle with unknown total quantity/weight (worst case: much smaller than claimed).

risks.risk: Condition issues not obvious from cover photos (missing pages, torn covers, heavy stains, mildew inside pages)
risks.proof: Close-up clips of 3–5 random books opened to the first/last pages showing page condition, plus a close-up of any damaged/stained areas.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed condition (assume some may be damaged/with defects).

risks.risk: Duplicates or many low-value/unauthentic copies reducing resale value
risks.proof: A list/photo grid showing the titles and counts (or a spreadsheet photo) for the full set, including ISBNs if visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic assorted set with possible duplicates and mixed value.

risks.risk: Edition/format mismatch (paperback vs hardback, older editions) affecting demand
risks.proof: Photos of the copyright/printing page for several representative books (front matter) showing edition/printing year and format.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming paperback/unknown editions with average demand.

risks.risk: Some titles may be missing or not as shown (photos may not represent the full bundle)
risks.proof: A full inventory photo showing all books together (or multiple wide shots covering the entire bundle) so the visible titles match the total.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming the photos are not complete and the bundle may contain fewer of the higher-demand titles.

proof_requests: Send a video of the full bundle being weighed on the certified scale with the reading clearly visible (and the certification visible).
Provide close-up clips of 3–5 randomly selected books opened to show internal page condition (no missing pages, no mildew/stains).
Show a wide shot (or multiple wide shots) covering the entire bundle so we can confirm the total number of books and whether the photos represent the full set.
Provide a title list with counts (or a clear grid) and, if possible, ISBN/copyright-page photos for a few key titles to confirm editions.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the item type as assorted business/self-help/relationship paperback books, so it can be priced at its worst case for an unknown-quantity, mixed-condition bundle; the seller’s weight claim is not verifiable from the report.
